response.justification: While the candidate possesses extensive software development experience, strong communication skills, and relevant exposure to investment banking, they critically lack the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development expertise on the Windows platform. This core technical requirement is not met, making them unsuitable for this specific C++ Developer role.
strengths: Over 10 years of professional software development experience, fitting the seniority requirement.
Demonstrated experience in Investment Banking (RIDE Capital) fulfills part of the domain expertise.
Strong communication skills evident through workshops, talks, and personal branding.
concerns: Lack of mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience; only 6 months explicitly mentioned.
No clear evidence of strong SQL experience specifically with SQL Server and/or Oracle.
Limited explicit experience with the Windows development platform for C++.
